name: LiveDataKeyLifecycleV1
new_instance: generate exactly 32 random bytes with secrets.token_bytes
DPAPI-protect as purpose live_data_dek into security/live-data-key.dpapi before database creation
create SQLCipher database only through LLD-01 connection factory consuming SqlCipherConnectionSecurityProvider
key connection with SQLCipher raw 32-byte key form
verify expected SQLCipher provider/core/settings and sqlite_master readability before migration
never expose READY until migrations/integrity checks complete
existing_instance: require live-data-key.dpapi present, owner-only, canonical and purpose-bound
open SQLCipher provider; apply raw key before any schema query
verify cipher_version/core/profile before LLD-01 connection safety pragmas/migrations
wrong/missing/unwrappable key or plaintext/cipher mismatch blocks startup without destructive repair
password_change: must not read, rewrite or rotate live DEK envelope except ordinary startup access already required
restore: verified backup may supply recovered source DEK inside encrypted backup payload; target DPAPI re-protects it only after full staged restore verification
rules: no database open through stdlib sqlite3 is authoritative after this contract is accepted
WAL/SHM/journal behavior must remain under same SQLCipher connection profile
key material never enters SQL text logging, diagnostics, audit or exception strings
